title: [3.0beta11] Dash temporary basal rates precision: calculating plus of every 0,01 instead of 0,05
symptom: When an over 100% temporary basal rate is running on the Omnipod Dash, the IOB counter increments in 0.01 steps instead of 0.05 steps, which is the pump's insulin dosing precision.
cause: The thread does not establish a root cause; it is discussed as a possible misunderstanding. The maintainers state it is not a real bug because IOB can have lower resolution than the minimum pod delivery step.
fix: No fix was provided; the issue was dismissed as not a real bug.
evidence_quote: I don't think this is a real bug. IOB can have lower resolution than the minimum pod delivery step.
